questions.question: Which of the following applies to you? Select any that apply.
options: I have taken antibiotics in the last 3 months

effects.safety: Context only; does not lower a wellness score.
effects.report: May be used to tailor context and recommendations. A positive medication response should not be interpreted as a health deficit.

questions.logic: Neither is mutually exclusive with the other two choices.

questions.question: How much alcohol do you typically drink in an average week?

effects.safety: Not a diagnosis or direct cardiovascular score.
effects.report: Can be described as a lifestyle exposure and interpreted alongside sleep, weight/metabolic and cardiovascular-related answers.

questions.question: How often do you experience noticeable changes in your mood or emotional state?

effects.report: Higher frequency contributes to the Mood, Stress & Emotional Balance signal.

questions.question: Do you have any diagnosed food allergies?

effects.safety: Safety gate / recommendation filter. No wellness-score penalty.
effects.report: Used to filter or qualify recommendations. The answer should never be presented as evidence of poor health.

questions.question: Do you regularly have noticeable dark circles under your eyes?

effects.report: No core report effect in the current model.

questions.reason: Non-specific observation with insufficient value for the outcome model.

design_note: Q06 and Q09 are profile/safety questions rather than health-score questions. Q10 is retained here only to document the removal decision.
